text.speaker: Jackie Tree
text.text: Welcome. Tonight is a meal for eight and a trial of what we can do together.

text.speaker: Jackie Tree
text.text: Bunny brought the guests. Frankie turned my nodding into a plan. I cooked.

text.speaker: Jackie Tree
text.text: Milo supplied the sound and will greet us. Vivian did the styling. Rita made the ceramic service and has her own work to present.

text.speaker: Jackie Tree
text.text: Felix repaired and tested the gate. Mr. Stringer is joining us to discuss renewal and the promised repair.

text.speaker: Jackie Tree
text.text: We can talk about future collaborations. Tonight promises nobody a date or a new job.

text.speaker: Jackie Tree
text.text: And we’ve got him right where we want him: in the front row for Rita’s work.

text.speaker: Mr. Stringer
text.text: You could have led with “front row.”

text.speaker: Rita Stringer
text.text: Then you’d have found something heavy to do at the back.

source_obligations: All eight named and accurately credited; trial/future/date/job limits; complete innocuous sentence resolves fragment; no signature yet.
VC03_RESOLVED is required for the final public introduction; cue inspection and rehearsal remain available beforehand.

records.text: We understood the meal, the trial, and what isn’t promised. Say it to them.
